a spare, upright old woman of sixty-five, deeply lined face, wrinkles at the eyes and mouth, silver-white hair pinned flat under a plain black cap. A long, fine-boned face, grey eyes that measure you, a pursed, patient mouth. A plain black dress, a tailor's measuring tape of knotted white cord round her neck, a fold of white linen over her left shoulder.

a thin country woman in her late fifties, worn by a hard year, lined weathered face, holding herself very straight. Iron-brown hair gone grey at the temples, parted flat under a plain white headscarf tied under the chin. Deeply lined forehead, level grey eyes a little too dry, mouth closed against being pitied. A dark wool bodice buttoned to the throat.

a small, upright old housekeeper of seventy, white hair scraped back under a starched white linen cap tied with a bow. Narrow, scrubbed, wrinkled face, a firm thin mouth, pale blue eyes. A plain dark gown with a grey woollen collar, and a heavy brass ring of keys pinned at her breast.

a gaunt village sexton, a man in his early sixties, clean-shaven with a small nick on the jaw. Thin, flat hair the colour of old salt. Pale lashes, pale watchful downcast eyes, deep lines either side of a closed mouth. A black coat buttoned up to a worn white collar, a heavy ring of iron keys hanging at his chest.

a round-faced, quick-eyed village baker, a woman of fifty, a smear of white flour along one cheekbone. Bright chestnut hair bundled under a flour-dusted linen cap, a few curled strands escaped. A broad, easy mouth halfway to a joke, dimples, a warm half-smile. A clean flour-dusted apron over a plain bodice.

a lean farm woman of forty, a sheaf-binder, in grey light before dawn. A dark wool hood pulled up, hiding her hair except one pale-straw wisp at the temple, a single ear of cut wheat tucked into the hood's edge. High cheekbones, wind-chapped skin, wide unblinking grey eyes, lips just parted as if whispering. A coarse brown cloak clasped at the throat.

a thick-necked quarry hauler in his early forties, shoulders hunched into a canvas collar. Cropped black hair with fine grey quarry dust still in it. A flattened nose broken once, black stubble, quick dark eyes that watch the hand rather than the face, and a half-grin that never reaches the eyes. A loose canvas coat with a bulging lapel.

a weathered river ferrywoman in her early forties, one eyebrow raised. Dark black-brown hair in one thick, wet-looking braid over her left shoulder. Sun-and-wind-reddened cheeks, light hazel eyes narrowed as if reading a hand across a table. A stiff oilskin collar turned up over a salt-stained shirt.

a stooped, guarded neighbour woman in her early sixties, lined and weary. Grey-brown hair in two thin plaits pinned flat over a dark kerchief. Heavy-lidded eyes shadowed by sleepless nights, a downturned mouth, a long chin. A faded blue shawl drawn shut at the neck, and a small iron door-key hanging on a cord round her neck.

a lanky young tannery hand of twenty-five, shoulders drawn up as if against a noise. Sandy hair cropped short and uneven, flecked with lime dust. A long freckled face, anxious pale-green eyes, a tuft of grey wool pushed into one ear. A bleached canvas smock with the neck stained green-brown.

a narrow, tight-lipped village chandler in his early sixties, lined and pinched. Sparse grey hair combed in thin strands across a freckled scalp. A long nose, pinched cheeks, sharp light eyes. A tallow-stained brown apron over a collarless shirt, and a stub of unlit candle tucked behind one ear.

a worn-out baker's wife in her early fifties, lined and tired, who has been crying. Dishwater-blonde hair in a loose knot, half undone, grey at the roots. Tired, slightly reddened eyelids, a small smile put on out of habit, a dusting of white flour on her cheeks with two clean tear tracks through it, and a faint streak of flour on her forehead. A plain brown bodice.
